name: Cassie & Co.
description:
Cassie & Co. is an American drama series broadcast on NBC as a mid-season replacement. 13 episodes were produced, but it was pulled after four episodes in February 1982, with the rest airing in the summer.

Angie Dickinson stars as Cassie Holland, a tough, divorced ex-cop who becomes a private detective, taking over a detective agency with her ex-con secretary Meryl (Dori Brenner) and gym instructor Benny (A. Martinez).

videos.title: The Golden Silence
videos.overview: Cassie comes to the assistance of Benny's girlfriend's imprisoned father who has been framed for murder.

videos.title: Replay
videos.overview: A son hires Cassie to clear his father of a murder conviction that happened fifteen years ago. Cassie finds a cold trail and forgetful witnesses.

videos.title: Gorky's Army
videos.overview: Cassie's newest case is investigating a suspected murder takes an unusual turn. She learns of a construction using faulty materials in buildings that could become death traps.

videos.title: Dark Side of the Moon
videos.overview: Cassie is hired to protect a successful author whose past threatens to catch up to him. It turns out he's on parole for murder.

videos.title: One Thief Too Many
videos.overview: Cassie is employed by a shady millionaire to recover stolen paintings.

videos.title: Anything for a Friend
videos.overview: Cassie's parolee secretary is arrested as an accessory to robbery and enlists her boss to find the real culprit.

videos.title: Man Overboard
videos.overview: A insurance company is dubious about the cause of death of an extremely wealthy client. To avoid a hefty payout, they retain Cassie and her firm to investigate.

videos.title: Friend in Need
videos.overview: After a successful lawyer is found murdered, Cassie is asked to investigate. But complications ensue when Cassie discovers the attorney's wife is the mistress of the man who trained her.

videos.title: There Went the Bride
videos.overview: A mail order bride disappears and the distraught family asks Cassie's company to locate her. The investigators find more than a missing person but a criminal scheme to defraud.

videos.title: Fade Out
videos.overview: When the negative of a potential blockbuster movie goes missing, the studio fears financial ruin. The bosses bring Cassie with her crew in to uncover what occurred and save the company.

videos.title: Lover Come Back
videos.overview: Cassie is hired by a young woman to locate her former boyfriend who mysteriously disappeared a year earlier.

videos.title: A Ring Ain't Always a Circle
videos.overview: A series of small crimes plague a boxing training center. But the situation escalates endangering the boxers' lives. Cassie and firm are called in to find the perpetrator.
